game.name: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City
game.rules:
__**TIMING**__

All Vice City speedruns are timed using the real time that has passed starting from the specified starting point up until your category's specified conditions are satisfied. However, you are welcome to use the load removal tool within LiveSplit to display time without loads as "game time", which is activated through the splits editor when the game is set properly.

__**RESTRICTIONS**__

* For full-game PC runs, the game must be restarted between each attempt. **Any PC runs with a new game confirmation prompt, shown only if it's not a fresh start, will be rejected.** AHK may be used to reset the game more optimally, but it may not be used during the run.
* The Frame Limiter must remain **ON** in the game options.
* Any and all instances of NG+ are banned.
* Files belonging to different versions of the game may not be mixed.
* Using OS functions to affect the game in an unintended way during the run (such as skipping KYFC final cutscene by tabbing out) is prohibited.
* No cheat codes.
* No loading of saves made outside of the current attempt.
* All modifications/tools besides the ones listed **[here](https://www.speedrun.com/gtavc/thread/w0b2j)** are banned. **This includes skins files and MP3 files not provided by the game.**

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
**TIMING**

Timing starts when the new game loading screen disappears, and ends upon losing control of Tommy after killing Sonny on 'Keep Your Friends Close...'

- The run ending does not count if Tommy dies before the final cutscene begins, even if you do not immediately fail the mission.

categories.name: Any% (No SSU)
categories.rules:
**TIMING**

Timing starts when the new game loading screen disappears, and ends upon losing control of Tommy after killing Sonny on 'Keep Your Friends Close...'

- The run ending does not count if Tommy dies before the final cutscene begins, even if you do not immediately fail the mission.



**ADDITIONAL RESTRICTIONS**

- [Script Stack Underflow](https://www.reddit.com/r/speedrun/comments/4vp5ui/wr_new_skip_found_in_vice_city_shaves_20_minutes/d60ugoe/) is banned from use in this category.

categories.name: All Missions
categories.rules:
__**TIMING**__

Timing starts when the new game loading screen disappears, and ends when every mission which changes the save file name has been passed. **For clarification, this includes Distribution (Ice Cream Mission) but does not include Checkpoint Charlie.**

__**TIMING**__

Timing starts when the new game loading screen disappears, and ends when every objective that counts towards the percentage counter has been completed. 

__**ADDITIONAL RESTRICTIONS**__

* Doing one objective multiple times and then skipping others is not allowed. It is possible the counter reaches 100% before the run is finished.

categories.name: All Hidden Packages
categories.rules:
__**TIMING**__

Timing starts when the new game loading screen disappears, and ends when all 100 hidden packages have been collected.

categories.name: Finish
categories.rules:
- Only **ONE** mission instance is allowed to be active at any time; no instance stacking of the same mission or with other missions.
- No unintended script execution is allowed to be used to pass the mission, such as executing the mission cleanup command during the mission.
- Cheats may be used **before the run** to make more convenient **setups that are possible without cheats**. **DO NOT** leave any cheat effects active during the run itself.

categories.name: All Robberies
categories.rules:
__**TIMING**__

Timing starts when the new game loading screen disappears, and ends when all 15 store knock-offs have been completed. Please display the store knockoffs completed in the Stats menu after your run to make verification easier.

categories.name: All Unique Stunts
categories.rules:
__**TIMING**__

Timing starts when the new game loading screen disappears, and ends when all 36 Unique Stunts have been completed.

categories.name: All Rampages
categories.rules:
__**TIMING**__

Timing starts when the new game loading screen disappears, and ends when all 35 rampages have been completed.
